steps.title: Open the Evidence page
steps.narration: This iteration refactored the forward aggregate calculator to use bounded memory. Let's verify the Evidence page still loads with all its claim cards intact.
steps.point_out: The page shows 7 claim cards, each with its title and badge fully rendered.

steps.title: Scroll to the drawdown expectations table
steps.narration: The backend now chunks its accumulators, so the historical data tables should load without memory pressure.
steps.point_out: The first card's 'Historical drawdown & dry-spell expectations' table shows real figures like phases, max drawdown depth, and time to recover.

steps.title: Verify the Backtest page
steps.narration: The core backtest computation is unchanged; its caller now uses bounded accumulation.
steps.point_out: The page displays the dataset coverage panel with real metrics (price history range, universe size, trading days).

steps.title: Open Factor Lab to spot-check research surface
steps.narration: Factor Lab shares a similar join pattern that this iteration fixed in a sibling function. Let's confirm it loads.
steps.point_out: The page shows the Factor Lab heading and the factors table renders with real Rank-IC values.
